newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Unioil enters stock swap scheme.
newsitem.headline: Unioil enters stock swap scheme.

text.p: Unioil & Gas Development Co Inc signed a deed of exchange with Westmont Investment Corp (Wincorp) for 1.257 billion shares in the oil exploration firm recently turned into a holding company.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Tuesday, Unioil said Wincorp controlling shareholders which include Ebecom Holdings Inc assigned a total of 816.5 million Wincorp shares in exchange for the 1.257 billion Unioil shares.
The share swap scheme will be subject to the approval of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of the proposed increase in Unioil's authorised capital stock to five billion pesos.
Unioil said upon the approval of the SEC, Wincorp shareholders will become the controlling stockholders of Unioil.
The company did not say how much stake Wincorp will have with the signing of the deed.
Unioil last year changed its primary purpose from an oil exploration firm to a holding company.
Wincorp is owned by a group of Filipino investors led by banker Edgardo Espiritu.
